title: Blocked, Not Prompted
hero_prompt: Bauhaus stage-design gouache on paper in the manner of Oskar Schlemmer, flat geometric colour shapes with visible brush texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a bare theatre stage seen from a dramatic worm's-eye low angle, plain geometric blocks (cubes, a ramp, a tall column) arranged with deliberate precision, and a jointed wooden artist's mannequin placed on the highest block in a bold striding pose, one hard spotlight cutting a sharp diagonal; the drama built entirely from where the blocks and the figure were put. Grey card blocks with accents of red, yellow and blue.
icon_prompt: Bauhaus emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a bright yellow ground, no shading or gradients: a jointed artist's mannequin in a bold striding pose standing on top of a single cube. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
